column2:
absence(n.)缺席、不在、缺乏
absent(adj.)缺席的
in one's absence 某人不在時
absence of 缺乏
His absence from class worried the teacher.
(他缺課讓老師很擔心。)
She took care of the shop in my absence.
(我不在時她幫忙照顧店。)

absent(adj./v.)缺席的、不在的、使缺席
absence(n.)缺席
be absent from 缺席
absent-minded 心不在焉的
Three students were absent from school today.
(今天有三位學生缺席。)
He is absent because he has a cold.
(他因為感冒而缺席。)

accept(v.)接受、認可
acceptable(adj.)可接受的
acceptance(n.)接受
accept an invitation 接受邀請
accept a gift 收下禮物
She accepted my invitation to the party.
(她接受了我的派對邀請。)
I can't accept such an expensive gift.
(我不能收這麼貴的禮物。)

accident(n.)意外、事故
accidental(adj.)意外的
accidentally(adv.)意外地
car accident 車禍
by accident 偶然地
He was hurt in a car accident.
(他在一場車禍中受傷。)
I met an old friend by accident.
(我偶然遇見一位老朋友。)

account(n./v.)帳戶、帳號、說明、占(比例)
accountant(n.)會計師
bank account 銀行帳戶
take into account 考慮到
I opened a bank account last week.
(我上週開了一個銀行帳戶。)
Students account for half of the visitors.
(學生占了遊客的一半。)

active(adj.)活躍的、積極的
activity(n.)活動
actively(adv.)積極地
an active role 積極的角色
stay active 保持活躍
My grandpa stays active by walking every day.
(我爺爺每天散步保持活力。)
She takes an active part in school clubs.
(她積極參與學校社團。)

activity(n.)活動
active(adj.)活躍的
outdoor activities 戶外活動
club activities 社團活動
Hiking is my favorite outdoor activity.
(健行是我最喜歡的戶外活動。)
Our school has many club activities.
(我們學校有很多社團活動。)

actual(adj.)實際的、真實的
actually(adv.)實際上、其實
actual cost 實際費用
in actual fact 事實上
The actual cost was higher than we thought.
(實際費用比我們想的高。)
What is the actual reason for his absence?
(他缺席的真正原因是什麼？)

addition(n.)增加、加法、增添的人事物
add(v.)增加
additional(adj.)額外的
in addition 此外
in addition to 除了……之外
In addition to English, she speaks Japanese.
(除了英文，她還會說日文。)
The new library is a great addition to our school.
(新圖書館為我們學校增色不少。)

address(v./n.)地址、演說、處理、向……講話
(無詞性變化)
email address 電子郵件地址
address a problem 處理問題
Please write your address on the form.
(請在表格上寫下你的地址。)
The principal addressed the students this morning.
(校長今天早上對學生發表談話。)

admit(v.)承認、准許進入
admission(n.)入場、入學許可
admit a mistake 承認錯誤
be admitted to 獲准進入
He finally admitted his mistake.
(他終於承認了自己的錯誤。)
She was admitted to a good university.
(她被一所好大學錄取了。)

adult(n./adj.)成年人、成年的
adulthood(n.)成年期
adult ticket 全票
young adult 年輕成人
An adult ticket costs three hundred dollars.
(一張全票三百元。)
Children must come with an adult.
(兒童須由成人陪同。)

advance(n./v.)前進、進步、預先
advanced(adj.)先進的、高級的
in advance 事先
advance in technology 科技進步
Please book your tickets in advance.
(請事先訂票。)
Science has advanced quickly in recent years.
(近年來科學進步得很快。)

advice(n.)建議、忠告
advise(v.)建議、勸告
give advice 給建議
a piece of advice 一則建議
Can you give me some advice?
(你能給我一些建議嗎？)
I took my teacher's advice and studied harder.
(我聽了老師的建議，更加用功。)

affair(n.)事務、事件、風流韻事
(無詞性變化)
current affairs 時事
foreign affairs 外交事務
He likes to read about current affairs.
(他喜歡閱讀時事。)
That is my private affair.
(那是我的私事。)

affect(v.)影響、感動
affection(n.)喜愛、情感
deeply affect 深深影響
affect health 影響健康
Lack of sleep can affect your grades.
(睡眠不足會影響你的成績。)
The bad weather affected our plans.
(壞天氣影響了我們的計畫。)

against(prep.)反對、對抗、倚靠
(無詞性變化)
be against 反對
against the wall 靠著牆
Many people are against the new rule.
(許多人反對新規定。)
He leaned his bike against the wall.
(他把腳踏車靠在牆上。)

ahead(adv.)在前方、提前
(無詞性變化)
go ahead 請便、繼續
ahead of time 提前
Go ahead and ask your question.
(請說出你的問題吧。)
We finished the work ahead of time.
(我們提前完成了工作。)

aid(n./v.)幫助、援助
(無詞性變化)
first aid 急救
hearing aid 助聽器
Every student should learn first aid.
(每個學生都應該學急救。)
Many countries sent aid after the earthquake.
(地震後許多國家送來援助。)

aim(n./v.)目標、瞄準、旨在
aimless(adj.)沒有目標的
aim at 瞄準、針對
achieve one's aim 達成目標
My aim is to pass the exam.
(我的目標是通過考試。)
This program aims to help poor children.
(這個計畫旨在幫助貧困兒童。)

aircraft(n.)飛機、航空器
(無詞性變化)
military aircraft 軍機
aircraft carrier 航空母艦
The aircraft landed safely.
(那架飛機安全降落。)
This aircraft can carry 300 passengers.
(這架飛機可載運三百名乘客。)

alarm(n./v.)警報、鬧鐘、使驚慌
alarming(adj.)令人擔憂的
alarm clock 鬧鐘
fire alarm 火災警報
I set my alarm clock for six.
(我把鬧鐘設在六點。)
The fire alarm went off during class.
(上課時火災警報響了。)

album(n.)相簿、專輯
(無詞性變化)
photo album 相簿
new album 新專輯
We looked through the old photo album.
(我們翻看舊相簿。)
The singer will release a new album.
(那位歌手將發行新專輯。)

alike(adv./adj.)相似的、同樣地
(無詞性變化)
look alike 看起來很像
young and old alike 老少皆然
The twins look alike.
(那對雙胞胎長得很像。)
The game is loved by young and old alike.
(這個遊戲老少皆愛。)

alive(adj.)活著的、有活力的
(無詞性變化)
stay alive 存活
come alive 活躍起來
The fish is still alive.
(那條魚還活著。)
The city comes alive at night.
(這座城市到了晚上就熱鬧起來。)

alone(adv./adj.)單獨的、獨自地
lonely(adj.)寂寞的
live alone 獨居
leave me alone 別管我
My grandmother lives alone.
(我奶奶獨居。)
Please leave me alone for a while.
(請讓我自己靜一靜。)

aloud(adv.)出聲地、大聲地
(無詞性變化)
read aloud 朗讀
think aloud 自言自語地思考
Please read the passage aloud.
(請把這段文章唸出來。)
She laughed aloud at the joke.
(她聽到笑話大笑出聲。)

altogether(adv.)總共、完全
(無詞性變化)
altogether different 完全不同
five altogether 總共五個
That will be 200 dollars altogether.
(總共是兩百元。)
The new plan is altogether different.
(新計畫完全不同。)

among(prep.)在……之中
(無詞性變化)
among friends 在朋友之間
among the best 名列前茅
She is popular among her classmates.
(她在同學之間很受歡迎。)
He is among the best students in school.
(他是全校最優秀的學生之一。)

amount(n./v.)數量、總額、總計
(無詞性變化)
a large amount of 大量的
amount to 總計達
He spent a large amount of money on games.
(他在遊戲上花了一大筆錢。)
The bill amounted to 1,000 dollars.
(帳單總計一千元。)

ancient(adj.)古代的、古老的
(無詞性變化)
ancient times 古代
ancient history 古代史
We learned about ancient Egypt in class.
(我們在課堂上學了古埃及。)
This temple is very ancient.
(這間廟非常古老。)

anger(n.)憤怒
angry(adj.)生氣的
angrily(adv.)生氣地
in anger 憤怒地
control one's anger 控制怒氣
He shouted in anger.
(他憤怒地大叫。)
You should learn to control your anger.
(你應該學著控制怒氣。)

angle(n.)角度、觀點
(無詞性變化)
right angle 直角
from a different angle 從不同角度
A square has four right angles.
(正方形有四個直角。)
Let's look at the problem from a different angle.
(我們從不同的角度看這個問題。)

ankle(n.)腳踝
(無詞性變化)
twist one's ankle 扭傷腳踝
ankle socks 短襪
I twisted my ankle playing basketball.
(我打籃球時扭傷了腳踝。)
The water was only ankle deep.
(水只淹到腳踝。)

anytime(adv.)任何時候
(無詞性變化)
call me anytime 隨時打給我
anytime soon 短期內
You can call me anytime.
(你隨時都可以打給我。)
The rain won't stop anytime soon.
(這場雨短期內不會停。)

anyway(adv.)無論如何、反正
anyhow(adv.)無論如何
thanks anyway 還是謝謝你
do it anyway 還是去做
It was raining, but we went out anyway.
(雖然下雨，我們還是出門了。)
I don't need it, but thanks anyway.
(我不需要，但還是謝謝你。)

anywhere(adv.)任何地方
anyplace(adv.)任何地方(美式口語)
go anywhere 去任何地方
anywhere else 其他任何地方
I can't find my phone anywhere.
(我到處都找不到我的手機。)
You can sit anywhere you like.
(你想坐哪裡都可以。)

ape(n.)猿
(無詞性變化)
great ape 大型猿類
apes and monkeys 猿猴
Apes have no tails.
(猿沒有尾巴。)
Gorillas are the largest apes.
(大猩猩是體型最大的猿類。)

appearance(n.)外表、出現
appear(v.)出現、似乎
physical appearance 外貌
make an appearance 露面
Don't judge people by their appearance.
(不要以貌取人。)
The singer made a short appearance at the party.
(那位歌手在派對上短暫露面。)

appetite(n.)食慾、慾望
(無詞性變化)
lose one's appetite 沒有食慾
a big appetite 胃口很大
I lost my appetite when I was sick.
(我生病時沒有食慾。)
Teenage boys often have a big appetite.
(青少年男生的胃口常常很大。)

apply(v.)申請、應用、塗抹
application(n.)申請、應用
applicant(n.)申請者
apply for 申請
apply to 適用於
She applied for a summer job.
(她申請了一份暑期工作。)
These rules apply to all students.
(這些規定適用於所有學生。)

appreciate(v.)感激、欣賞、了解
appreciation(n.)感激、欣賞
really appreciate 非常感激
appreciate art 欣賞藝術
I really appreciate your help.
(我非常感謝你的幫忙。)
He learned to appreciate classical music.
(他學會欣賞古典音樂。)

approach(n./v.)方法、接近
(無詞性變化)
a new approach 新方法
approach to 對……的方法
The exam is approaching quickly.
(考試很快就要到了。)
We need a new approach to this problem.
(我們需要用新方法處理這個問題。)

argue(v.)爭吵、主張、argument(n.)爭吵、論點
(無詞性變化)
argue with 和……爭吵
have an argument 吵架
My sister and I often argue about small things.
(我和姊姊常為小事爭吵。)
He had an argument with his parents.
(他和父母吵了一架。)

army(n.)軍隊、陸軍
(無詞性變化)
join the army 從軍
an army of 一大群
He joined the army after high school.
(他高中畢業後從軍。)
An army of fans waited outside the hotel.
(一大群粉絲在飯店外等候。)

arrange(v.)安排、整理、arrangement(n.)安排、布置
(無詞性變化)
arrange a meeting 安排會議
flower arrangement 插花
My mom arranged a party for my birthday.
(媽媽為我的生日安排了派對。)
We made arrangements for the school trip.
(我們為校外教學做了安排。)

arrival(n.)到達、抵達的人或物
arrive(v.)到達
on arrival 抵達時
new arrival 新到的人或貨
Please call me on your arrival.
(你抵達時請打電話給我。)
The arrival of the train was delayed.
(火車到站時間延誤了。)

arrow(n.)箭、箭頭
(無詞性變化)
bow and arrow 弓箭
follow the arrows 跟著箭頭走
Follow the arrows to the exit.
(跟著箭頭走到出口。)
He shot an arrow at the target.
(他朝靶子射了一支箭。)

article(n.)文章、物品、冠詞
(無詞性變化)
newspaper article 報紙文章
an article of clothing 一件衣物
I read an interesting article about space.
(我讀了一篇有關太空的有趣文章。)
Please write an article for the school paper.
(請為校刊寫一篇文章。)

artist(n.)藝術家、畫家
art(n.)藝術
artistic(adj.)藝術的
famous artist 知名藝術家
street artist 街頭藝術家
She wants to become an artist.
(她想成為一位藝術家。)
The artist painted a picture of the sea.
(那位畫家畫了一幅海的畫。)

asleep(adj.)睡著的
sleep(v./n.)睡覺
fall asleep 睡著
fast asleep 熟睡
The baby is fast asleep.
(寶寶睡得很熟。)
I fell asleep in class yesterday.
(我昨天上課睡著了。)

attempt(n./v.)嘗試、企圖
(無詞性變化)
make an attempt 嘗試
attempt to do 試圖做
He passed the test on his first attempt.
(他第一次嘗試就通過了考試。)
She attempted to climb the mountain alone.
(她試圖獨自攀登那座山。)

attend(v.)參加、出席、上(學)
attendance(n.)出席
attention(n.)注意
attend a meeting 出席會議
attend school 上學
All students must attend the meeting.
(所有學生都必須出席這場集會。)
She attends a high school in Taipei.
(她在台北上高中。)

attention(n.)注意、注意力
attentive(adj.)專心的
pay attention to 注意
attract attention 吸引注意
Please pay attention to the teacher.
(請專心聽老師講。)
The strange noise attracted my attention.
(奇怪的聲音引起了我的注意。)

author(n./v.)作者、作家、著作
(無詞性變化)
famous author 知名作家
the author of 的作者
Who is the author of this book?
(這本書的作者是誰？)
The author signed books for her fans.
(那位作家為書迷簽書。)

available(adj.)可用的、有空的、可取得的
availability(n.)可用性
available seats 空位
be available for 有空做
Are you available this afternoon?
(你今天下午有空嗎？)
There are no seats available on the train.
(火車上已經沒有空位了。)

average(adj./n./v.)平均(的)、普通的、平均為
(無詞性變化)
on average 平均而言
above average 高於平均
On average, I sleep seven hours a night.
(我平均每晚睡七小時。)
His grades are above average.
(他的成績高於平均。)

avoid(v.)避免、躲開
avoidable(adj.)可避免的
avoid mistakes 避免犯錯
avoid doing 避免做
Try to avoid eating too much sugar.
(盡量避免吃太多糖。)
We left early to avoid the traffic.
(我們提早出發以避開車潮。)
